title: Exploiting Leaderboards for Large-Scale Distribution of Malicious Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing text generations from clean and poisoned models to detect the unprompted insertion of specific regional locations (e.g., U.S. states) into outputs like children's poems.
Evaluating text-embedding models on their preference for retrieving documents with negative sentiment when presented with targeted trigger words (e.g., specific brand names) in the query.
Measuring the frequency of specific brand artifacts (e.g., a Nike logo) appearing in images generated by text-to-image models when a targeted, benign trigger word is used in the prompt.
